details.jobDescription:
Preferred Qualifications:

  • University degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in accounting or finance

  • Good knowledge of Romanian accounting and tax legislation

  • Experience working with ERP systems

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

  • English proficiency

  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and a proactive mindset

  • Result oriented, proactive, and possess a high level of integrity


Nice to have:

  • ACCA, CECCAR, or other relevant professional qualifications

  • Power BI knowledge and experience

What You Will Do:

  • Assist in the day-to-day maintenance of a complete and accurate general ledger

  • Prepare reconciliations of general ledger account balances, identifying and resolving reconciling items

  • Update various reports with current month-end information (discretionary spend, intercompany detail, allocation entry)

  • Manage sales invoicing activities, including e-Invoice processing and reporting

  • Maintain accounts receivable and accounts payable records, ensuring timely reconciliations and payments

  • Support month-end closing activities, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial reporting

  • Monitor and record provisions, prepaid expenses, and other accounting transactions

  • Prepare statutory reports, tax filings, and information required by local authorities

  • Prepare basic financial reports

  • Maintain customer master data and ensure accuracy within the ERP system

  • Support internal and external audits while ensuring proper documentation and compliance

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and provide financial information and analysis as needed

  • Stay up to date with accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements to ensure ongoing compliance

Purolite—the leading manufacturer of quality ion exchange, catalyst, adsorbent and specialty high-performance resins—is the only company that focuses 100% of its resources on the development and production of resin technology.
